name: Fit Sheet Size Guides
author: fyfster

sections.description:
Fit Sheet Size Guides lets you paste measurements from Excel or Google Sheets, preview the table, and assign a size guide to a WooCommerce product category. You can override or hide the guide for individual products.

The plugin stores guides in WordPress and runs without an external service.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce and Fit Sheet Size Guides.
  2. Open Products > Size guides and add a guide.
  3. Paste cells from your spreadsheet, select the source unit, preview the table, and assign a category. The editor includes a sample table in centimeters.
  4. Publish the guide. On block themes, add a Shortcode block with [fit_sheet_size_guide] to your Single Product template.
